expectation_criteria:
For invoice INV-8841, we expect the system to:

Capture IBAN Number as MT40BANK22013000000012345678901.
Capture Voyage Number as V7X0042.
Assign the Voyage Code dimension with the value V7X0042 to every invoice line, with 100% confidence and labelled as “pre-assigned”.

The test should fail if any invoice line:

Is missing the Voyage Code dimension.
Has a Voyage Code other than V7X0042.
Has a Voyage Code confidence below 100%.
Does not have the Voyage Code labelled as “pre-assigned”.
